$comment: The master production schedule for one dinner service. `covers` is the build plan: change it and every downstream requirement (ingredients, intermediates, labor, machine time) scales through the BOM and routings. Values marked 'est' are modelling assumptions, not published figures.

courseGapMinutes.note: Time from one course being cleared to the next being fired.

pacing.note: Fit to the 3 to 3.5 hour meals reported by diners.

inventoryPolicy.note: Start-of-service stock is the BOM explosion for the planned covers times parFactor, rounded up to whole batches for intermediates.
